snippet.title: OBSERVATION PROTOCOL — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter a place that was never meant to be found.

Observe the facility through surveillance cameras, identify and report anything out of place, and follow the protocols given to you.

But when the power goes out, observation takes on a whole new meaning.

Observation Protocol is a liminal horror game focused on surveillance, exploration, and uncovering what shouldn't be there.

Available on Steam September 25, 2026.
